info.title: 🪤 Trap Channel
info.dashboard_hint: Customise the warning embed and penalty from the web dashboard.
info.usage:
`{prefix}trapchannel create [name] [timeout_minutes]` - Create a new trap channel
`{prefix}trapchannel set <channel> [timeout_minutes]` - Use an existing channel
`{prefix}trapchannel penalty <timeout|kick|ban|delete> [timeout_minutes]` - Change the penalty
`{prefix}trapchannel refresh` - Repost the warning
`{prefix}trapchannel disable` - Turn the trap off

errors.publish_failed: ❌ I could not post the warning in the trap channel. Check that I can send messages and embeds there.
